H9001.d: Verbal vav: joined to verb with no intervening prefix (usually conversive) (futurepast)

H9002.d: Conjunctive vav - i.e. followed by prefix, suffix or non-verb (conjunctive) (‘and/but’)

H9008.d: Prefix hé interrogative: at the start of a question

H9009.d: Prefix hé article: "the" for a subject, not object

H9010.d: Suffix aleph: definite article "the" in Aramaic

H9017.d: Punctuation Pe paragraph: ends a literary section

H9018.d: Punctuation Sameq paragraph: ends a lectionary section

H9019.d: Punctuation Inverted Nun paragraph: ends a lectionary section
